title: Blocksize Agentic Market Intelligence

offersHint: Live multi-asset market data for AI agents with provenance, starter credits, x402, and examples. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.blocksize.info/mcp/server/

toolsPreview.name: search_pairs
toolsPreview.description: Discover supported crypto, equity, FX, and metal symbols before using the paid HTTP API. Returns up to 50 catalog matches with asset class, available services, and pricing tier; it is free, read-only, and never returns live prices or starts payment.

toolsPreview.name: list_instruments
toolsPreview.description: List the supported instruments for one Blocksize service. This is free, read-only catalog metadata; it does not fetch live prices, create accounts, or start x402 payment.

toolsPreview.name: get_pricing_info
toolsPreview.description: Inspect current per-call prices, bulk credit tiers, and supported Solana and Base USDC settlement networks. This is free and read-only planning metadata; it does not initiate payment.

toolsPreview.name: get_product_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Inspect Blocksize raw data, supported equity ticker bid/ask, and premium agent-native workflow products, including starter-credit positioning, credit costs, suggested paid prices, endpoint templates, and upgrade path. This is free and read-only.

toolsPreview.name: get_workflow_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Build the exact paid HTTP endpoint, method, starter-credit cost, and example body for a premium Blocksize workflow. This is free and read-only; it does not fetch live data, charge credits, or start x402.

toolsPreview.name: get_market_data_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Build the exact x402-protected HTTP URL for one live market-data request. Returns method, URL, service notes, pricing docs, and next steps; it is read-only and does not fetch prices, charge a wallet, or submit payment.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search Blocksize documentation and catalog metadata by keyword. This free read-only search returns document and instrument ids for fetch; it does not return live prices or start payment.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one document or instrument guide returned by search. This is free, read-only content retrieval with no account, credential, payment, or live-price side effects.
